result_summary:
### Review: heartbeat lease checks

- claim_token is verified via getLeaseSnapshot before each renewal.
- One minor issue: HEARTBEAT_ERROR path re-reads the lease but does not log the token mismatch reason.

findings.message: Lease re-read after a heartbeat error does not record why ownership was lost.

fixes.description: Emit a LEASE_RECHECK event before re-reading lease ownership.
